info.name: Parity fixture
info.description: Common, two buffers with feedback, textures, samplers and unsupported inputs.

renderpass.name: Buffer A
renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 c, in vec2 p) { vec2 uv = p / iResolution.xy; c = texture2D(iChannel0, uv) * 0.98 + texture2D(iChannel1, uv) * 0.02; }

renderpass.name: Buffer B
renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 c, in vec2 p) { c = texture2D(iChannel0, p / iResolution.xy); }

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.code: void mainImage(out vec4 c, in vec2 p) { vec2 uv = p / iResolution.xy; c = texture2D(iChannel0, uv) + texture2D(iChannel1, uv) + texture2D(iChannel2, uv) * shared(1.0); }

renderpass.name: Sound
renderpass.code: vec2 mainSound(int s, float t) { return vec2(0.0); }
